doc: compare(gen, ref) from the two measure dicts (inputs: gen_zonal_lat, gen_zonal, gen_hist and ref_zonal_lat, ref_zonal, ref_hist, the keys of measure()): zonal_rmse = sqrt(mean((gen.zonal - ref.zonal)^2)) over the bands with |gen.zonal_lat| < 70 (strict; the latitudes come from the GENERATED dict and ref_zonal_lat is never read), hist_l1 = sum |gen.hist - ref.hist|; returned here as [zonal_rmse, hist_l1]. Float64 arithmetic on lists: 1e-9. The reference dict carries its OWN zonal_lat, here all 0 (a made-up grid that would put every band inside +-70): the bands are still selected by the generated latitudes (-60, -20, 0, 20, 60: rmse = sqrt((0.5^2 + 0.2^2 + 0.1^2 + 0.1^2 + 0^2) / 5) = 0.249, not the 0.370 of all seven bands); a port that reads the reference latitudes gets the other number. hist_l1 = 0.5.
